items.description: Tick-to-complete with participant capture: open the Weekly Planner, tick an incomplete task card, enter 4 participants in the inline prompt, Confirm, then open Daily Agenda for that date.
items.expected_result: Inline participants prompt appears with number input + Confirm/Cancel; card completes (strikethrough, faded, green check) and page refreshes; Daily Agenda shows Completed and its Edit Log opens the VisitLog with participant count 4.

items.description: Tick an incomplete task, leave participants blank, Confirm.
Re-open (un-tick) a completed task, then open Daily Agenda and edit the log for that task.
items.expected_result: Card returns to incomplete (tick box back, strikethrough removed); VisitLog still exists; log data (metrics, photos, participants) is preserved; Completion History shows Completed then Reopened.

items.description: Re-complete the task from scenario 3 by re-ticking and entering 6 participants.
items.expected_result: Task completes with a green success toast/banner; the SAME VisitLog is updated to 6 participants (no second log).

items.description: On Weekly Planner, hover a completed task and inspect the Edit affordance (also verify a completed task that has NO VisitLog).
items.expected_result: Edit links to the VisitLog edit form (not task edit) when a log exists; falls back to task edit when there is no VisitLog.

items.description: For a task that already has a VisitLog, navigate to Add Log with ?task=<id>.
items.expected_result: Redirected to the existing VisitLog's edit form (with next preserved), not a blank create form.

items.description: Immediately after completing, tick again (or POST /complete/ twice).
items.expected_result: Second request returns already_completed; no duplicate VisitLog or history spam.

items.description: Simulate a network failure during tick.
items.expected_result: UI reverts (tick box returns, task not completed).

items.description: Run the data-integrity SQL checks at the bottom of the UAT file after testing.
items.expected_result: No task has more than one VisitLog; every completion/reopen has a history row.
